ChangeResourceGroup.title: Change the resource group of an instance
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Transfers a resource to a different resource group.

ConvertPostPayOrder.title: Convert a pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance
ConvertPostPayOrder.summary: Converts a pay-as-you-go instance to a subscription instance.

CreateConsumerGroup.title: Create a consumer group
CreateConsumerGroup.summary: Calls CreateConsumerGroup to create a consumer group.

CreatePostPayInstance.title: Create a pay-as-you-go instance
CreatePostPayInstance.summary: Creates a pay-as-you-go instance and returns the instance ID and order ID.

CreatePostPayOrder.title: Create a pay-as-you-go instance
CreatePostPayOrder.summary: Pay-as-you-go instances are billed based on the actual usage of purchased resource specifications. You use resources first and then pay for them. This billing method is suitable for testing or short-term scenarios with unpredictable traffic peaks. This topic describes how to call CreatePostPayOrder to create a pay-as-you-go instance.

CreatePrePayInstance.title: Create a subscription instance
CreatePrePayInstance.summary: Creates a subscription instance and returns the instance ID and order ID.

CreatePrePayOrder.title: Create a subscription instance
CreatePrePayOrder.summary: Creates a subscription instance. Subscription instances require upfront payment before you can use resources. This billing method is suitable for long-term stable business scenarios.

CreateSaslUser.title: Create a SASL user
CreateSaslUser.summary: Creates a Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) user by calling CreateSaslUser.

CreateScheduledScalingRule.title: Create a scheduled elastic scaling policy
CreateScheduledScalingRule.summary: Creates a scheduled elastic scaling policy for a serverless instance after deployment.

DeleteInstance.title: Delete an instance
DeleteInstance.summary: Deletes an instance after a subscription or pay-as-you-go instance is released. This topic describes how to call the DeleteInstance operation to delete an instance.

DeleteSaslUser.title: DeleteSaslUser
DeleteSaslUser.summary: You can call the DeleteSaslUser operation to delete a Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) user.

DeleteScheduledScalingRule.title: DeleteScheduledScalingRule
DeleteScheduledScalingRule.summary: After a Serverless instance is deployed, you can call this API operation to delete its scheduled scaling policy configuration.

DescribeSaslUsers.title: DescribeSaslUsers
DescribeSaslUsers.summary: You can call DescribeSaslUsers to query SASL users.

EnableAutoGroupCreation.title: Enable free use of groups
EnableAutoGroupCreation.summary: Enables or disables the free use of groups by calling EnableAutoGroupCreation.

EnableAutoTopicCreation.title: EnableAutoTopicCreation
EnableAutoTopicCreation.summary: This topic describes how to call the EnableAutoTopicCreation operation to enable or disable automatic topic creation and modify the default number of partitions for automatically created topics.

GetAllInstanceIdList.title: GetAllInstanceIdList
GetAllInstanceIdList.summary: Queries the IDs of all instances in the current account.

GetAllowedIpList.title: GetAllowedIpList
GetAllowedIpList.summary: The GetAllowedIpList operation retrieves the IP address allowlist.

GetAutoScalingConfiguration.title: GetAutoScalingConfiguration
GetAutoScalingConfiguration.summary: After a Serverless instance is deployed, you can call this API operation to query the auto scaling configuration of the instance.

GetConsumerList.title: GetConsumerList
GetConsumerList.summary: Retrieves a list of consumer groups.

GetConsumerProgress.title: GetConsumerProgress
GetConsumerProgress.summary: Queries the consumption status of a consumer group.

GetInstanceList.title: GetInstanceList
GetInstanceList.summary: Queries information about instances in a specified region.

GetKafkaClientIp.title: GetKafkaClientIp
GetKafkaClientIp.summary: Retrieves the IP addresses of Kafka clients.

GetQuotaTip.title: GetQuotaTip
GetQuotaTip.summary: Retrieves the usage quotas for topics and partitions.

GetRiskList.title: GetRiskList
GetRiskList.summary: Queries the list of threats on an instance.

GetTopicStatus.title: GetTopicStatus
GetTopicStatus.summary: Retrieves the message sending and receiving status of a topic.

GetTopicSubscribeStatus.title: GetTopicSubscribeStatus
GetTopicSubscribeStatus.summary: Retrieves the subscription status of Groups for a topic.

ListRebalanceInfo.title: ListRebalanceInfo
ListRebalanceInfo.summary: Queries the details of rebalancing tasks.

ListTagResources.title: ListTagResources
ListTagResources.summary: Queries the list of tags that are attached to resources.

ModifyInstanceName.title: ModifyInstanceName
ModifyInstanceName.summary: You can modify the name of an ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance after it is deployed. This topic describes how to call the ModifyInstanceName operation.

ModifyPartitionNum.title: ModifyPartitionNum
ModifyPartitionNum.summary: This operation modifies the number of partitions in a topic.

ModifyScheduledScalingRule.title: ModifyScheduledScalingRule
ModifyScheduledScalingRule.summary: After you deploy Serverless instances, you can call this API operation to modify their scheduled scaling policy.

ModifyTopicRemark.title: ModifyTopicRemark
ModifyTopicRemark.summary: Modifies the remark of a topic.

QueryMessage.title: Query topic messages
QueryMessage.summary: Queries messages stored in a topic by message creation time or offset.

StartInstance.title: StartInstance
StartInstance.summary: You must purchase and deploy an ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance before you can send and receive messages. This topic describes how to deploy an instance by calling the StartInstance operation.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: You can call the TagResources operation to attach tags to resources.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: You can call UntagResources to detach tags from resources.

UpdateAllowedIp.title: UpdateAllowedIp
UpdateAllowedIp.summary: You can call the UpdateAllowedIp operation to edit the IP whitelist for an ApsaraMQ for Kafka instance. The whitelist specifies the IP addresses and ports that are allowed to access the instance.

UpdateConsumerOffset.title: UpdateConsumerOffset
UpdateConsumerOffset.summary: The UpdateConsumerOffset operation resets the consumer offset of a consumer group.

UpdateInstanceConfig.title: UpdateInstanceConfig
UpdateInstanceConfig.summary: After an instance is deployed, you can modify configurations such as enabling Access Control List (ACL) and SSL, the message retention period, and the maximum message size. This topic describes how to call the UpdateInstanceConfig operation to modify the configuration of an instance.

UpdateTopicConfig.title: UpdateTopicConfig
UpdateTopicConfig.summary: After a topic is created, you can modify its configurations, such as the message retention period and maximum message size. This topic describes how to call this API operation to modify topic configurations.

UpgradeInstanceVersion.title: UpgradeInstanceVersion
UpgradeInstanceVersion.summary: Upgrades the version of an instance.
